top_signals.title: Bessent touts bond market as 10-year Treasury yield spikes
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent downplayed short-term bond moves even as he touted the U.S. market, saying, "what happens over a month doesn't matter."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
